purpose: Inputs for fixed-crystal flow verification; not a reproduction of a published tank or a calibrated growth experiment.
property_limits: Single binary KDP-water CFD reference point at 30 C; reported density/viscosity were calculated and diffusivity estimated. No numerical uncertainties supplied. Do not extrapolate to another temperature/composition or treat these as independently measured constants.

crystal.purpose: Fixed verification obstacle, not a crystallographic KDP habit. Growth and dissolution disabled.

nonisothermal_flow: solution heat capacity and thermal conductivity versus temperature/composition
thermal expansion and temperature boundary histories
solutal_buoyancy: density derivative with an explicit concentration basis and validity range
growing_crystal: solution-density/partial-volume closure and interface mass balances
actuated_experiment: pump inlet/outlet geometry and flow rates
quality: independent measured inclusion, transmission or usable-crystal target
